description: Input contract of abep_sim/thermal_life.py (THL lane). Every input is required; there are no defaults. thermal_life.check_feasibility refuses (ValueError) when an input is missing, carries a different unit string than listed here (no unit conversion is done), lacks a source, or (for numbers) lacks evidence_level 1-7 and a docs/EVIDENCE.md quantity_type. 'from' names the lane/module expected to produce the input; 'now' is its state on 2026-09-26. Component names coordinate with the bus-power boundary component names; this file does not import or depend on that module.

number.quantity_type: measured | digitized | inferred | reconstructed | model-derived | assumed
number.uncertainty: non-empty statement (a value/band, or 'unquantified' / 'TBD - requires ...' explicitly)
number.applicability_domain: non-empty statement of where the value applies

id.source: who decided and where it is recorded

input_record.paths: non-empty list of rejection paths; each path is {'kind': 'conductance' | 'radiation', plus that kind's number inputs listed under rejection_path}

wall_flux_provenance.applies_to: hall_discharge.wall_ion_flux_m2s and hall_discharge.wall_ion_energy_eV; both records carry the key 'wall_flux_provenance' with identical content
wall_flux_provenance.why: gap G11 (docs/evidence/wall_life/sputter_yield_db_v1.json): wall flux drives wall heat and erosion life; CLAUDE.md: screening candidates never produce performance, erosion/lifetime use requires wall_life_trustworthy, no silent fallbacks

admitted_hallmap.produced_by: thermal_life.hallmap_wall_inputs (binds the id to the queried map: map meta ensemble_member_id and hallthruster_commit must match; ion_wall_losses must be true)
admitted_hallmap.rule: ensemble_member_id passes abep_sim.hall_ensemble.require_admitted at check time (screening candidates and unknown ids refused); trustworthy and wall_life_trustworthy are true; hallthruster_commit equals the hallthruster_bridge/PINNED.toml commit; map_meta_sha256 is a 64-hex sha256 (its match to a map file is NOT re-verified at check time: no map registry in v1); record quantity_type 'model-derived'

measured_hardware.rule: every evidence_record field is a non-empty string; record quantity_type 'measured'

wall_flux_provenance.otherwise: ValueError (explicit refusal; no PASS / FAIL / NOT_DEMONSTRATED is produced)

coil_current_A.now: TBD (P5 coil currents are unpublished; no Vyovrinda design yet)

external_heat_W.from: thruster thermal model: discharge heat reaching the coil

hot_spot_allowance_K.from: coil thermal model (EEE-INST-002 note 1/a uses 10 C for MIL-style parts)

hall_discharge.node: channel walls (lumped); anode heat is accounted but has no thermal check in v1

discharge_power_W.now: TBD (credible set empty: no admitted HallMap)

wall_ion_flux_m2s.from: HallMap field wall_ion_flux_m2s of an ADMITTED ensemble member with wall_life_trustworthy = true (thermal_life.hallmap_wall_inputs), or measured hardware data with its evidence record; the record must carry wall_flux_provenance (see top-level wall_flux_provenance)
wall_ion_flux_m2s.now: TBD (credible set empty, no hardware measurement: every wall-flux input is refused today)

wall_ion_energy_eV.from: HallMap field wall_ion_energy_eV of an ADMITTED ensemble member with wall_life_trustworthy = true (thermal_life.hallmap_wall_inputs), or measured hardware data with its evidence record; the record must carry wall_flux_provenance (see top-level wall_flux_provenance)
wall_ion_energy_eV.now: TBD (credible set empty, no hardware measurement: every wall-flux input is refused today)

wall_area_m2.from: Vyovrinda channel geometry: inner + outer wall area over z <= L

wall_electron_temperature_eV.from: solver output (not a hall_map_schema_v1 field); must be the T_e of the same solve whose sheath is in wall_ion_energy_eV (not checked in v1)
wall_electron_temperature_eV.now: TBD (needs a schema extension: owner decision)

wall_see_yield.from: solver output (WallSheath SEE yield, not a hall_map_schema_v1 field); must be the gamma of the same solve whose sheath is in wall_ion_energy_eV (not checked in v1)
wall_see_yield.now: TBD (needs a schema extension: owner decision)

anode_electron_temperature_eV.from: solver output near the anode (not a hall_map_schema_v1 field)

additional_wall_heat_W.from: any wall heat not covered by the ion and electron terms (e.g. recombination, absorbed plasma radiation); zero only with a documented justification

wall_material_record.from: wall material selection (record id in limits_v1.json)

wall_environment.from: owner decision (ABEP air path: atomic-oxygen plasma has no sourced limit)

allowable_erosion_depth_m.from: Vyovrinda wall geometry (erodible thickness before the magnetic circuit is exposed)

peak_to_average_flux_ratio.from: axial wall-flux profile (hall_map_schema_v1 gives only the z <= L average)

volumetric_sputter_yield_m3_per_ion.from: sourced sputter yield of the wall material for the ion mix at wall_ion_energy_eV

bus_power_allocation_W.from: bus-power boundary component 'ecr_magnet' (must be 0 W: permanent magnets only)

min_Br_fraction_required.from: ECR magnetic design: smallest Br(T)/Br(20 C) that keeps the resonance zone

demag_field_max_A_per_m.from: magnetostatic design: largest opposing field at any magnet point

knee_field_A_per_m.from: manufacturer demagnetization curve of the grade (H_K,90 or H_D5)

knee_field_at_T_C.from: temperature of the curve used for knee_field_A_per_m

rf_power_W.from: bus-power boundary component 'rf_source' (RF power delivered to the antenna)

ecr_source.node: ECR source structure (lumped); heat reaching the magnets is accounted in ecr_magnet

rf_power_W.from: bus-power boundary component 'ecr_source' (microwave power delivered to the coupler)

heat_fraction_antenna_copper.from: ECR source design / test (coupler conductor loss)

cathode.node: cathode assembly (lumped); emitter temperature from Richardson-Dushman

heater_steady_state_duty.from: cathode dossier / operations (0 for a self-heated cathode)

emitter_plasma_heating_W.from: cathode dossier (insert-plasma heating in steady state)

emission_current_A.from: HallMap discharge_current_A plus keeper current (thermally limited regime)

emitter_pO2_Torr.from: cathode dossier (O2 partial pressure at the emitter; feed purity / air path)
